$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for C2PA assertion labels. Read by BOTH
These two drifted apart once already: the Signer's fail-closed
allowlist did not contain the labels the emitter produced, and every
sign call raised ValueError. Nothing caught it because no CI runs the
tests. If you add a label to the emitter, add it here, or the Signer
will refuse to sign — which is the correct failure, but a preventable
TOE placement follows GPSA v3 §C.1.4, which names three TOE roles:
Client, Application tier, Signer. The Application tier 'constructs
the C2PA manifest structure' and is INSIDE the TOE, so assertions it
authors are created_assertions. Only assertions whose CONTENT
originated outside the TOE are gathered.

created.$comment: Authored inside the TOE. Base labels; a trailing .vN is matched version-insensitively.

gathered.$comment: Content originated outside the TOE. Preserved with the asset, honestly labelled external. Add only after reviewing the Client-supplied schema.
